mapper.sql: event_id, event_name, event_date, area, TO_CHAR(start_time, 'HH24:MI') AS start_time, TO_CHAR(end_time, 'HH24:MI') AS end_time, venue, event_url, note, display_order, is_published, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM exhibition_event ORDER BY event_date DESC, display_order, event_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exhibition_event ( event_name, event_date, area, start_time, end_time, venue, event_url, note, display_order, is_published, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at ) VALUES ( #{eventName}, #{eventDate}, #{area}, CAST(NULLIF(#{startTime}, '') AS TIME), CAST(NULLIF(#{endTime}, '') AS TIME), #{venue}, #{eventUrl}, #{note}, #{displayOrder}, #{isPublished}, #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE exhibition_event SET event_name = #{event.eventName}, event_date = #{event.eventDate}, area = #{event.area}, start_time = CAST(NULLIF(#{event.startTime}, '') AS TIME), end_time = CAST(NULLIF(#{event.endTime}, '') AS TIME), venue = #{event.venue}, event_url = #{event.eventUrl}, note = #{event.note}, display_order = #{event.displayOrder}, is_published = #{event.isPublished}, update_user = #{event.updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
